entities.summary: Sir Kingsley Charles Dunham was one of the leading British geologists and mineralogists of the 20th century. He was a Professor of Geology at the University of Durham from 1950 to 1971. He was later Professor Emeritus from 1967 to 2001. He was director of the British Geological Survey from 1967 to 1975.
